content_sections.heading: ICGEB Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICGEB Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICGEB Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICGEB Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Associate (Computational Biology), 1 for Research Associate (Enzyme Engineering), and 1 for Junior/Senior Research Fellow.

content_sections.heading: ICGEB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate (Computational Biology): PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Systems Biology, Computer Science, or related field; Strong programming skills (Python, R); Familiarity with synthetic biology and genome engineering; Publications in relevant areas. Research Associate (Enzyme Engineering): PhD in Biotechnology or related area; Familiarity with synthetic biology concepts and genome engineering; Publications in relevant areas. Junior/Senior Research Fellow: M.Sc. in Biotechnology or related area.

content_sections.heading: ICGEB Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Associate (Computational Biology): As per DST norms Research Associate (Enzyme Engineering): As per DST norms Junior/Senior Research Fellow: As per DST norms

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Associate / Research Fellow posts at ICGEB is 20 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How can I apply for the ICGEB Research Associate / Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with bio-data and required documents, then send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the Research Associate (Computational Biology) post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate (Computational Biology) position, candidates need a PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Systems Biology, Computer Science, or a related field, along with strong programming skills in Python and R, and familiarity with synthetic biology and genome engineering.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for all the advertised posts, including Research Associate and Research Fellow, will be as per DST norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ICGEB?
faq.answer: ICGEB has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the Research Associate and Research Fellow positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of ICGEB?
faq.answer: The official website of the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology is www.icgeb.org.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit restrictions for these posts?
faq.answer: Specific age limit details are not provided in the summary. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for precise age criteria and any applicable relaxations.

faq.question: Q10. What qualifications are required for the Junior/Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Junior/Senior Research Fellow position, candidates must hold an M.Sc. degree in Biotechnology or a related field.
